 High Court Of Andhra Pradesh At Amaravati

sentences.text: OFFICE No. NOTE 10. 10.01.2025 RNT, J & VN, J  I.A.No.1 of 2024 in MACMA No.725 of 2024  MACMA No.107 of 2024 has been filed by  the insurance company, challenging the award of  the Tribunal under the Motor Vehicles Act.

2. MACMA No.725 of 2024 has been filed by  the claimants for enhancement of compensation.
 3.
The appeal filed by the claimants is  beyond limitation.
I.A.No.1 of 2024 has been filed  for condonation of delay.
4. Any objection to the said application has  not been filed by the other respondents in MACMA No.725 of 2024.

5. Heard Sri P.Siva Prasad, learned counsel for the petitioners and Sri M.Rahul, learned counsel representing Ms.S.Pranathi, learned counsel for the 4th respondent-insurance company.
6.

After having considered the submissions advanced; that the appeal filed by the insurance company is pending, and also having gone through the contents of the affidavit filed in support of the application, we find that the cause shown is sufficient.
M.A.C.M.A.No. 107 of 2024 and MACMA No.725 of Post the matter after four weeks.
